# What the neo-tax plugin sends

The neo-tax plugin reports metadata about AI coding sessions so Neo.Tax can attribute AI token spend to the pull requests and tickets it already tracks. This page lists every field it can send. The list is generated from the allowlist inside the agent; any field not listed here is removed on the engineer's machine before it is written to disk or sent.

## Identity

The only personal identity Neo.Tax receives is the email the engineer confirms at enrollment, which is stored with the device's key rather than sent with each event, plus the repository-level git `user.email` on `session.opened` as a signal for joining sessions to pull-request authors.

## Never sent

Prompt text, completion text, tool inputs, tool outputs, file paths, the working-directory path, and session titles never leave the machine.

## Fields by event kind

### `session.closed`

| Field | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | Version of the wire contract the event conforms to. |
| `device_id` | Random id minted for this device at enrollment. |
| `harness` | Which coding harness ran the session, for example claude-code. |
| `harness_version` | Version of the harness, as recorded in its transcript. |
| `agent_version` | Version of the neo-tax-agent binary. |
| `session_id` | The harness's own random id for the session. |
| `event_kind` | Which kind of session event this is. |
| `sent_at` | When the agent created the event. |
| `ended_at` | When the session ended. |
| `reason` | Why the harness ended the session, for example logout or exit. |
| `dropped_events` | How many events the agent discarded because its local queue was full. |

### `session.opened`

| Field | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | Version of the wire contract the event conforms to. |
| `device_id` | Random id minted for this device at enrollment. |
| `harness` | Which coding harness ran the session, for example claude-code. |
| `harness_version` | Version of the harness, as recorded in its transcript. |
| `agent_version` | Version of the neo-tax-agent binary. |
| `session_id` | The harness's own random id for the session. |
| `event_kind` | Which kind of session event this is. |
| `sent_at` | When the agent created the event. |
| `started_at` | When the session started. |
| `entrypoint` | How the harness was launched, for example cli or sdk. |
| `source` | Why the session started: startup, resume, clear, or compact. |
| `repo` | Repository host, owner, and name parsed from the git remote URL, lowercased; null outside a git repository. |
| `repo.host` | Git host, for example github.com. |
| `repo.owner` | Organization or user that owns the repository. |
| `repo.name` | Repository name. |
| `branch` | Current git branch name; null on a detached HEAD or outside git. |
| `head_sha` | Commit hash HEAD pointed at. |
| `git_user_email` | The repository-level git user.email, used only to join sessions to pull-request authors. |
| `dropped_events` | How many events the agent discarded because its local queue was full. |

### `session.turn`

| Field | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | Version of the wire contract the event conforms to. |
| `device_id` | Random id minted for this device at enrollment. |
| `harness` | Which coding harness ran the session, for example claude-code. |
| `harness_version` | Version of the harness, as recorded in its transcript. |
| `agent_version` | Version of the neo-tax-agent binary. |
| `session_id` | The harness's own random id for the session. |
| `event_kind` | Which kind of session event this is. |
| `sent_at` | When the agent created the event. |
| `message_id` | The harness's id for the assistant message. |
| `request_id` | The model vendor's API request id for the message. |
| `subagent_id` | Id of the subagent that produced the turn; null on the main thread. |
| `timestamp` | When the assistant message was recorded. |
| `model` | Model name that produced the message. |
| `branch` | Current git branch name; null on a detached HEAD or outside git. |
| `head_sha` | Commit hash HEAD pointed at. |
| `usage` | Token counts for the message. |
| `usage.input` | Uncached input tokens. |
| `usage.output` | Output tokens. |
| `usage.cache_write_5m` | Input tokens written to the five-minute prompt cache. |
| `usage.cache_write_1h` | Input tokens written to the one-hour prompt cache. |
| `usage.cache_read` | Input tokens read from the prompt cache. |
| `usage.service_tier` | Vendor service tier the request ran on. |
| `usage.source` | Where the counts came from: payload, transcript, or unknown. |
